params.name: status
params.label: Status
params.default: Connect Source to cache the shot automatically. Edits wait for Apply / Refresh.

params.name: apply
params.label: Apply / Refresh
params.hint: Apply pending settings and refresh the entire shot cache. Display-only changes reuse neural predictions.

params.name: refresh_status
params.label: Refresh Status
params.hint: Read the current operation or last result without invalidating image renders.

params.name: input_linear
params.label: Input Is Linear
params.hint: Enable for scene-linear RGB. Convert log or wide-gamut material upstream; this does not change primaries.

params.name: unpremultiply
params.label: Unpremultiply Input
params.hint: Enable only when source RGB is multiplied by its alpha. Leave off when source alpha is only a hint.

params.name: resolution
params.label: Internal Resolution
params.hint: Reduces inference resolution, then returns the original frame size. Half is useful while working.

params.name: auto_vram
params.label: Automatic GPU Memory
params.hint: Choose a Hann window and staged processing using available GPU memory.

params.name: memory_gb
params.label: GPU Budget (GiB, 0 = Auto)
params.hint: Soft budget for automatic profile selection, not a hard CUDA allocation limit. Leave room for Resolve.

params.name: cache_folder
params.label: Cache Folder
params.hint: Local SSD recommended. Stores reusable neural predictions and worker.log.

params.name: cache_gb
params.label: Cache Limit (GiB)
params.hint: Old results are evicted. The current shot is retained even if larger than this limit.

params.name: temporal
params.label: Cache Whole Shot
params.hint: Automatically processes the complete source range on first connection. Playback reads prepared output frames. Disable only for single-frame work; click Apply to commit.

params.name: auto_range
params.label: Use Clip Frame Range
params.hint: Disable for a trimmed range or unbounded Fusion generators.

params.name: hann_chunk
params.label: Temporal Window
params.hint: Manual Hann window. 1 means independent frames. Used when automatic memory selection is off.

params.name: hann_stride
params.label: Window Stride
params.hint: Must not exceed Temporal Window; half the window gives 50% overlap.

params.name: carry_hint
params.label: Carry Predicted Hints
params.hint: Carry the model's auxiliary matte across overlapping Hann windows. Disable for authoritative per-frame hints.

params.name: process_shot
params.label: Apply Whole Shot
params.hint: Enable Cache Whole Shot and apply pending settings.

params.name: cancel
params.label: Cancel Processing
params.hint: Stops this inference pass. Resolve's render cancellation also stops the worker.

params.name: hint_source
params.label: Hint Source
params.hint: Connect a matte or roto image to the Alpha Hint input in Fusion, then select Alpha Hint Input.

params.name: hint_channel
params.label: Hint Channel
params.hint: White selects foreground; black selects background. This conditions the neural model, not the final alpha multiplication.

params.name: hint_frames
params.label: Hint Frames
params.hint: First Frame applies at the beginning of the temporal shot. Enable temporal processing for propagation.

params.name: hint_quality
params.label: Alpha Hint Strength
params.hint: 0.95 for a reliable matte; 0.75 for rough automated hints; lower values reduce trust.

params.name: output_linear
params.label: Linearize Output
params.hint: Unclamped scene-linear RGB. Disable for display-coded sRGB. Alpha is always coverage.

params.name: keep_original
params.label: Keep Original in Solid Areas
params.hint: Blend back original RGB where predicted alpha is above 0.95, before despill.

params.name: despill_amount
params.label: Despill Amount
params.hint: Suppress screen-channel excess in linear light. Does not alter the matte or rerun the model.

params.name: low_vram
params.label: Low GPU Memory
params.hint: Exact staged inference with features on disk. Used when Automatic GPU Memory is off.

params.name: linear_brightness
params.label: Linear Brightness
params.hint: Experimental preconditioning, inverted after inference.

params.name: help
params.label: Workflow
params.default:
Connect Source to cache the whole shot automatically. Fusion shows render activity while preparing.
Adjust controls, then click Apply / Refresh once. Playback keeps the last applied settings until then.
Display-only changes reuse the neural result. Refresh Status reads the latest progress.
Use Resolve Deliver for export. Independent CorridorKey 2.0 integration; see README for licenses.
